headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Yoav Gallant warned Hamas that if an Israeli soldier or citizen is abducted, the entire city of Gaza would be evacuated. Speaking at a memorial ceremony for the Yom Kippur War fallen, Gallant stated Israel would not retreat from its red line in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the Strip is demilitarized.

headlines.snippet: Syrian President Bashar al-Assad told Barak Ravid that he understands the events of October 7th and the suffering of innocent people. headlines.title: מקרון באמירה מקוממת: "חמאס מעולם לא פעל בגדה המערבית"
headlines.snippet: French President Emmanuel Macron stated at the UN General Assembly that Hamas has never operated in the West Bank, questioning the basis for violations in the region. He emphasized the need to respect the Palestinian people's right to exist. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu responded by calling Macron's statement "unthinkable absurdity," noting that a French citizen was recently killed by a Hamas operative in the West Bank. Izzy Eisenkot also commented, calling the statement "extremely detached from reality."

headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron, who was murdered in a shooting attack near Neve Tzuf, was laid to rest at the cemetery in Ali Zahav. His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, said goodbye, thanking his father for his life. His wife, Merav, described Natanel as the most involved father.

headlines.title: נתנאל שקרון הוא הנרצח בפיגוע במעיין בבנימין; המחבל נלכד בבית חולים ברמאללה
headlines.snippet: Natanel Shkaron is identified as the victim of a shooting attack near a spring in Benjamin. The attacker, who opened fire on people at the spring near Neve Tzuf, fled the scene. Shkaron, a father of six from Ali Zahav, was critically wounded and later died at the hospital. The attacker was apprehended in a Ramallah hospital after being wounded during a pursuit by IDF forces. Another attacker was killed while attempting a ramming attack in the northern West Bank shortly after.
